title: -R1 Air Racer TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Scorpion EXO R1 Air Racer TC-2 is engineered for high-velocity circuit stability, purpose-built for riders demanding uncompromising high-speed aerodynamic stability and track-certified protection. Built around a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell weighing 1446g, its multi-density EPS matrix is aerodynamically sculpted to isolate cabin noise to ~90 dB while dissipating kinetic impact forces across DOT, ECE 22.05 benchmarks. Inside, 3D laser-cut cheek pads tailor naturally to an Intermediate Oval profile with dedicated eyewear relief channels, secured by track-proven Double D-Ring retention for confident all-day riding.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track riding; requires precise fitment due to aerodynamic shell shape.

technical_analysis: Features Advanced multi-composite aerodynamic shell geometry engineered for optimal impact absorption and stability paired with Anti-scratch Class-1 optical shield with Pinlock anti-fog lens compatibility and toolless quick-release. The interior utilizes Multi-density EPS liner with moisture-wicking washable interior lining and speaker cutout pockets with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.

Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Scorpion EXO's Track / Race lineup, the -R1 Air Racer TC-2 brings Global Premium engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Scorpion EXO R1 Air Racer TC-2 represents Scorpion EXO's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~90 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Scorpion EXO R1 Air Racer TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
